source.author: verg
source.text_english: I do not seek Italy of my own accord.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non sponte feror, nec nunc mihi iungere montes mens tamen aut summo deposcere fulmen Olympo.
reuse.text_original: sed non sponte feror, nec nunc mihi iungere montes / mens tamen aut summo deposcere fulmen Olympo.
reuse.text_english: but I am not carried of my own will, nor now does my mind demand to join the mountains for me or to snatch the thunderbolt from lofty Olympus.
